module purpose: This module decodes selected ctrl_i instruction fields and alu_cp_alu to recognize enabled bit-manipulation operations, captures rs1_i, rs2_i, shamt_i and cmp_i, executes the requested function with direct combinational logic or multi-cycle shifter/clmul state, and registers the result on res_o with a matching valid_o completion flag.

use-case flows.value: decode and accept an enabled bit-manipulation command, then launch the serial shifter, launch carry-less multiply, or complete immediately
capture operand, shift-amount and comparison context for the current operation
update shifter/clmul working state and compute per-operation result candidates
register the selected result and report completion
clear controller state, captured context, shifter/clmul state, and result output when rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Bit-manipulation command decode and unit-start decision
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow computes one-hot cmd bits from ctrl_i.ir_opcode, ctrl_i.ir_funct12 and ctrl_i.ir_funct3 under the EN_Z* build options at lines 132-161, then qualifies the decode with ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu in valid_cmd at line 164. In S_IDLE the controller uses that decision to pulse shifter.start for serialized cz/cpop/rot at lines 200-202, pulse clmul.start at lines 203-205, or complete immediately at lines 206-208. Integrity is established because corrupting this decision changes which function runs or whether a multi-cycle unit is launched; availability is also established because a matching enabled command causes one of those start or immediate-complete actions. Although the flow graph lists cmd and valid_cmd as not reached, their own GATED_BY records and these RTL lines establish the decode and acceptance logic.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched execution context and iterative working state for the current operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: When ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu is high, the controller captures cmp_i, rs1_i, rs2_i and shamt_i at lines 187-191. Later cycles use the held context and working state: rs1_reg, sha_reg and less_reg feed result logic at lines 301, 310, 313 and 402; shifter.sreg, shifter.cnt, shifter.bcnt and shifter.cnt_max are initialized and updated for shift/count operations at lines 243-259 and 281, or computed in the EN_FAST_SHIFT build at lines 298-314; clmul.cnt and clmul.res are initialized and updated for carry-less multiply at lines 359-368 when EN_ZBKC. Integrity is established because later result formation reads these held values at lines 394-414 and 456; availability is established because serialized operations depend on them remaining available until completion. The internal rs2_reg latch is not listed because its records show only forwarding into internal computation stages, so rs2_i remains the setting reference.

The XLEN-wide candidate results are computed in res_int at lines 389-456 from the captured execution context and working state. Only the decoded enabled operation is passed into res_out at lines 461-480, and output_gate registers the ORed selected value into res_o when valid is high at lines 491-496. Integrity is established because the consumer at res_o must receive exactly the value defined by these equations; availability is established for the completion cycle guarded by valid. res_out is not listed because it only gates and forwards already-computed candidates from res_int.

The report flow raises valid immediately for single-cycle commands at line 207 or, for multi-cycle execution, when the busy-state exit condition holds at lines 218-220; valid_o exports that decision at line 502. ctrl_state stores S_IDLE, S_START and S_BUSY and selects the sequencing branches at lines 195, 202, 205, 214 and 220. shifter.run supplies the serialized shift/count busy decision from the stop conditions at lines 274-285 when not EN_FAST_SHIFT, while clmul.run is derived from clmul.cnt at line 374 when EN_ZBKC; ctrl_i.cpu_trap can force immediate completion at line 218. Integrity is established because downstream logic must only observe completion under these RTL-visible conditions; availability is established because the module raises valid in the immediate-complete or done/trap cases implemented here.
